author: Raazeev Khawas Bhujel (SarcasticRadio)
review_text: What is wrong with this app? My money got over spent two times. First i used 150rs for topup while offline in sms mode but 850rs was transferred. I thought it was my own mistake. But today i used it again for topup i transferred 270 rs but again!!!! 850rs was transferred again. Idk what the hell is wrong with this but i want my money back man.. Are you guys doing a scam? Your system has been doing this since the last update. I want my money. It was good before. I'm giving it a 2 star for this.
